subject.title: Add an FxTwitter read transport for public lookups, threads, profiles, and search

question: Should Birdclaw core own and support an opt-in FxTwitter public-read transport, and if so should its initial contract be limited to post and thread/conversation ingestion?
rationale: VISION.md permits qualifying data surfaces but does not decide whether Birdclaw should depend on and support this specific public third-party service or the proposal's full endpoint breadth.

options.title: Approve a narrow MVP
options.body: Support explicit post lookup and thread/conversation ingestion first, with a hardened configurable HTTPS endpoint, attribution, capability errors, and no automatic fallback.

options.title: Approve the full surface
options.body: Accept profiles, timelines, search, and relationship lists as one broader core transport program with the associated schema and operational commitments.

options.title: Decline core ownership
options.body: Keep bird and xurl as the supported live transports and leave FxTwitter integration outside Birdclaw core.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow MVP
recommendation.body: Support explicit post lookup and thread/conversation ingestion first, with a hardened configurable HTTPS endpoint, attribution, capability errors, and no automatic fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the clearest authority for deciding whether a new third-party transport belongs in Birdclaw's supported core surface.
